Container.Name: DenDuty
Container.Overview: Den Duty is a self-hosted, tablet-first family chore tracker: chores on daily, weekday or one-off schedules, kids tap their raccoon on a family tablet to tick them off, parents approve, and points fill up goals and rewards. Custom points name and icon, an append-only points history, Home Assistant support, and strong sign-in for parents (passwords, two-factor, passkeys, Google).
Container.Requires: Optional: a Google OAuth client for Google sign-in.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and the generated session secret

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use to open the app, e.g. https://chores.example.com. Needed for Google sign-in and passkeys.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Fallback time zone for new homes (each home can change its own in Settings).

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on Google sign-in. Redirect URI: PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/google/callback

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: Optional. Goes with the Google client ID.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Optional. Your OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak...). Redirect URI: PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/oidc/callback

Config.Name: OIDC client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Goes with the OIDC issuer.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Optional. Goes with the OIDC issuer.

Config.Name: OIDC button name
Config.Description: Optional. The sign-in button says Sign in with this name.

Config.Name: Forward-auth header
Config.Description: Optional. Username header from a reverse proxy login like TinyAuth (usually Remote-User).

Config.Name: Forward-auth trusted proxies
Config.Description: Addresses allowed to send the forward-auth header: private, IPs or CIDRs.

Config.Name: Sign-up mode
Config.Description: Who can make a parent account: invite (needs a home join code), open, or closed. The first account is always allowed and becomes the admin.

Config.Name: Quick sign-in
Config.Description: Name-only sign-in for parents: lan (home network only), off, or anywhere. Leave empty for lan without Google, off with Google.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Reverse proxies allowed to set X-Forwarded headers. Defaults to loopback and private networks.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one automatically in the data folder.
